DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Viral Hepatitis with Hepatic Encephalopathy.

The significantly elevated INR (1.5), marked transaminitis, and hyperbilirubinemia confirm severe liver dysfunction. The new onset of agitation and personality changes are classic signs of hepatic encephalopathy. I will now request imaging of the abdomen to assess for complications like ascites or varices.
